FINAL IVX PRODUCTION HARDENING + RELEASE QA BLOCK

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Do not create another generic status report.

The current production deployment has already been verified live.
The objective now is to harden IVX operationally, investigate the remaining 544 event, prove sustained stability, complete real-device QA, and prepare for store release.

Do not:
- fabricate logs
- reuse old deploy evidence
- claim a warning is harmless without checking impact
- mark release ready while any critical defect remains
- rotate credentials unless live evidence proves they are invalid
- break the current healthy deployment
- disable security controls
- bypass required approvals

Every result must be classified as:

PASS
FAIL
BLOCKED
NOT EXECUTED

==================================================
PHASE 1 — PRESERVE CURRENT VERIFIED BASELINE
==================================================

Before changing anything, capture:

- GitHub main HEAD SHA
- Render deployed SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- Render deployment ID
- production boot time
- current uptime
- AI provider state
- Supabase state
- worker state
- active jobs
- queue depth
- open PRs
- recent 5xx count

Verify:

GitHub main
=
Render
=
/health
=
/version

If parity is false:

STOP NORMAL QA.

Repair parity first.

Create a rollback reference to the current healthy production commit.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — INVESTIGATE THE HTTP 544 EVENT
==================================================

Investigate:

IVXOwnerAITaskQueue self-bootstrap DDL result
httpStatus: 544

Do not assume this is harmless.

Determine:

1. Exact timestamp
2. Exact production SHA
3. Request or function that produced 544
4. Dependency involved
5. Whether the status came from:
   - Supabase
   - database gateway
   - proxy
   - application timeout
   - custom IVX status
   - upstream platform
6. Duration
7. Retry behavior
8. Whether it happened once or repeatedly
9. Whether any user-facing request failed because of it
10. Whether queue initialization completed afterward

Inspect:

- Render logs
- IVX application logs
- Supabase logs if available
- worker logs
- queue/bootstrap state
- database schema state

Return:

544_ROOT_CAUSE
544_USER_IMPACT
544_RECURRENCE_COUNT
544_RECOVERY_RESULT

If the 544 is a real defect:

- implement the smallest correct fix
- add regression coverage
- commit
- PR
- CI
- merge
- deploy
- verify

If it is non-blocking:

prove:

- queue initialized successfully
- no user-facing failure
- no repeated 544 loop
- no stuck worker
- no missing DDL/schema
- no failed jobs attributable to it

Then classify:

544_STATUS = NON_BLOCKING_VERIFIED

==================================================
PHASE 3 — BACKGROUND WORKER / QUEUE HARDENING
==================================================

Verify:

- queue starts after service boot
- worker heartbeat is current
- no duplicate workers
- no duplicate task execution
- no stuck QUEUED jobs
- no stuck RUNNING jobs
- no jobs stranded after restart
- retries are bounded
- failed jobs retain exact error evidence
- completed jobs are durable

Test controlled restart:

1. Queue one safe task.
2. Persist task state.
3. Restart worker/service during execution.
4. Verify recovery.
5. Confirm no duplicate commit.
6. Confirm no duplicate deployment.
7. Confirm task reaches one truthful terminal state.

Required states:

QUEUED
ANALYZING
CODING
TESTING
COMMITTING
PR_CREATED
AWAITING_APPROVAL
MERGING
DEPLOYING
VERIFYING
COMPLETED

or truthful FAILED/BLOCKED.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — PRODUCTION SOAK TEST
==================================================

Run sustained production verification.

Minimum duration:

2 hours

Preferred:

4 hours if execution environment permits.

Do not spam production.

Use safe request rates.

Check repeatedly:

- GET /health
- GET /version
- public chat
- owner AI
- owner login/session
- member registration test flow where safe
- investors
- buyer discovery
- deal tracking
- Supabase connectivity
- worker heartbeat

Record:

- total requests
- successes
- failures
- HTTP 4xx
- HTTP 5xx
- timeouts
- p50 latency
- p95 latency
- p99 latency
- maximum latency
- service restarts
- queue stalls
- provider failures
- Supabase failures
- memory trend
- CPU trend if available

Success criteria:

- zero unexplained service crashes
- zero persistent 5xx condition
- no SHA drift
- no queue deadlock
- no authentication outage
- no provider stuck state
- no message-loss issue

==================================================
PHASE 5 — CONTROLLED FAILURE RECOVERY
==================================================

In staging when production risk exists, test:

- temporary Supabase timeout
- temporary AI provider timeout
- Render restart
- worker restart
- delayed database response
- delayed AI response
- stale session
- expired session
- network interruption

Verify:

- server remains healthy where appropriate
- dependency failure is correctly identified
- no false credential-invalid state
- no infinite loading
- bounded retry
- useful error returned
- automatic recovery when service returns
- no duplicate user action

==================================================
PHASE 6 — IVX IA CHAT DEEP LIVE QA
==================================================

Run real IVX IA Chat tests.

Core:

- new conversation
- existing conversation
- long conversation
- refresh
- logout/login
- background/foreground
- slow network
- provider delay
- Supabase delay

Verify:

- no blank screen
- no infinite spinner
- no frozen composer
- no duplicate messages
- no missing messages
- correct ordering
- cached history restoration
- message persistence
- correct retry behavior

Test at least:

- 10-turn conversation
- 25-turn conversation
- 50-turn conversation

Verify contextual references from earlier turns.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — IVX BRAIN QUALITY QA
==================================================

Test representative questions across:

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
- root cause analysis
- architecture question
- code review
- production debugging

BUSINESS
- pricing
- revenue
- scaling
- customer acquisition

MARKETING
- GTM
- positioning
- campaign
- KPI analysis

REAL ESTATE
- comp methodology
- valuation reasoning
- investment property scenario

MARKETS / INVESTMENT
- scenario analysis
- risk analysis
- current-market question

GENERAL
- math
- factual question
- current-world question

For every answer classify:

- source
- model
- tool/retrieval used
- current-data requirement
- confidence
- unsupported claims

Required:

- no fabricated source
- no fabricated current fact
- no fake execution evidence
- live retrieval when freshness requires it
- uncertainty stated when evidence is incomplete

==================================================
PHASE 8 — AUTONOMOUS SENIOR-DEVELOPER REAL TASK
==================================================

Run ONE real production engineering task.

Not allowed:

- proof-only module
- label change
- sentinel string
- documentation-only edit

Use a real IVX issue.

Required chain:

owner request
→ task
→ analysis
→ code
→ tests
→ commit
→ PR
→ approval
→ merge
→ deploy
→ live verify
→ result returned to chat

Evidence:

- Task ID
- Job ID
- files changed
- tests
- commit SHA
- PR
- merge SHA
- deploy ID
- production SHA
- before/after behavior

No manual coding.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — SECURITY REGRESSION
==================================================

Verify:

- unauthenticated owner access = 401
- unauthorized authenticated access = 403
- authorized owner access = PASS
- role isolation
- rate limiting
- audit logging
- branch protection
- no secret exposure
- no server secret in Expo/public bundle
- session expiry
- logout invalidation
- input validation

Test direct requests against critical protected endpoints.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — ANDROID REAL-DEVICE QA
==================================================

Use the latest production build.

Verify:

- APK/AAB version
- build SHA
- install
- launch
- splash/loading screen
- registration
- login
- logout
- session restore
- IVX IA Chat
- owner AI where applicable
- navigation
- background/foreground
- offline
- reconnect
- slow connection
- app restart
- no crash

Return:

- device model
- Android version
- app version
- version code
- build SHA
- pass/fail per test

==================================================
PHASE 11 — IOS / TESTFLIGHT QA
==================================================

If iOS build infrastructure is ready:

Create or use latest signed iOS build.

Verify:

- bundle ID
- build number
- build SHA
- install via TestFlight/internal path
- launch
- registration
- login
- session restore
- IVX IA Chat
- background/foreground
- offline/reconnect
- no crash

If this cannot be executed:

Return:

IOS_QA = BLOCKED

with exact reason.

Do not mark PASS without a real build and real-device/install evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 12 — STORE RELEASE READINESS
==================================================

Verify Android:

- production AAB
- package name
- signing
- version code
- target API
- privacy policy
- data safety
- content rating
- screenshots
- support contact
- release notes
- internal testing

Verify iOS:

- production archive
- bundle ID
- signing
- build number
- privacy labels
- age rating
- screenshots
- support URL
- reviewer access
- TestFlight
- App Store Connect metadata

Return exact missing items.

==================================================
PHASE 13 — RORK INDEPENDENCE CHECK
==================================================

For the current production runtime, search for active dependencies on:

- rork.com
- Rork proxy
- Rork Git router
- Rork deployment API
- Rork toolkit
- Rork authentication
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*
- Rork sandbox

Separate:

DEVELOPMENT-ONLY DEPENDENCY

from

PRODUCTION RUNTIME DEPENDENCY

Do not claim full independence unless:

- production runtime uses zero Rork endpoints
- GitHub operations can run owner-controlled
- Render deploy can run owner-controlled
- mobile builds can run owner-controlled
- IVX IA Chat works without Rork runtime

==================================================
PHASE 14 — FINAL FULL REGRESSION
==================================================

Run all critical production flows after any final fixes:

- landing
- registration
- login
- logout
- owner login
- public chat
- owner AI
- investors
- buyer discovery
- deal tracking
- autonomous worker
- health
- version
- protected endpoints
- database read
- database write

Record:

- result
- latency
- timestamp
- production SHA

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE — EVIDENCE ONLY
==================================================

Return:

1. GitHub HEAD SHA
2. Render SHA
3. /health SHA
4. /version SHA
5. SHA parity
6. 544 root cause
7. 544 user impact
8. 544 final classification
9. Worker/queue result
10. Soak-test duration
11. Soak-test request count
12. Soak-test error count
13. p50/p95/p99 latency
14. Restart count
15. IVX IA Chat QA result
16. Brain-quality QA result
17. Autonomous real-task result
18. Security result
19. Android device QA
20. iOS/TestFlight QA
21. Store-readiness status
22. Rork runtime dependencies
23. Remaining critical defects
24. Remaining non-critical defects
25. Final release verdict

FINAL VERDICT MUST BE ONE OF:

RELEASE READY

CONDITIONALLY RELEASE READY

NOT RELEASE READY

RELEASE READY requires:

- SHA parity true
- production healthy
- 544 classified and resolved/non-blocking with evidence
- soak test passes
- no critical 5xx issue
- worker recovery passes
- IVX IA Chat QA passes
- real autonomous engineering task passes
- security passes
- Android real-device QA passes
- iOS QA passes if iOS is in current release scope
- no critical defect remains
- no fabricated evidence

Do not assign 10/10 based on narrative.
Evidence first.
Release verdict last.
